address_rule: PE constants use actual module load base + RVA. Heap pointers remain per-session identities, not portable IDs.

fields.0x98..0xB0: retain effective-stat raw32, names require field-specific proof

unit_minimal_windows.rule: Preserve signed and raw values; do not clamp negative HP or make absent data zero.

unit_minimal_windows.types: projection flag byte plus four pointer32 links

fields.0x1CC: leader-linked record, not guaranteed summoner ID

fields.0x214: logical X used by distance calculation
fields.0x218: logical Y used by distance calculation
fields.0x220/0x224: separate spatial-coordinate pair; do not alias to +214/+218

not_covered_by_unit_core: all object subtypes and dynamic effects

vm.capture: Keep raw header triplets, all active stack elements, each referenced block vector header and its ScriptElement pointer sequence; preserve order and zero script entries
vm.resume: PC already advances before handler dispatch. Do not blindly subtract 1 or restart ScriptBattle. PC equal to block length is a legal end-of-block condition.
vm.consistency: Compare four depths and block PC bounds as consistency diagnostics; snapshot races must remain explicit, not normalized.

runtime_map.owner: read manager+E8 and require expected G before following

layers.semantics: byte layer; complete terrain meaning unresolved
int32 sentinel layer; preserve 0x80000008, do not replace with zero
pointer-like object layer; pointed-to payload required separately

runtime_map.row_rule: Each layer points to a height-sized array of row pointers; rows need not be adjacent. Use independent per-row reads and total byte/row budgets.
runtime_map.source: Observe file or memory-input branch and identity separately from runtime cell contents. Map file hash alone does not certify all runtime layers.

time.battle_counters: E+1EED60 resettable, E+1EED64 absolute, E+1EED68 result gate
time.limit: module+(67B938-400000) initial tag, following DWORD current value
time.rule: Task-pass count is a distinct clock; keep finite/unlimited sentinel semantics and raw signed values.

rng.state: verified original game thread/fiber PTD+14 uint32
rng.PTD_slot_index: module+(65A9A4-400000), FLS or TLS depending native init branch
rng.getter_cache_slot_index: module+(65A9A8-400000), TLS of getter function pointer, NOT PTD
rng.getter_cache_api: TLS cache -> getter function -> PTD slot -> PTD+14
requirements: confirm owning context and selected FLS/TLS branch
resolve an already-existing PTD without invoking original getter/init/rand
record state at the same validated handoff boundary
keep all unresolved pointer/index values unresolved
rng.not_implemented: No new process/thread API reader, no OS-private layout assumptions, no allocation/write/suspend/hook.

phase_A: Capture immutable identity, participant links, Unit core and clock/VM/map header essentials first; persist raw bytes with per-group status before optional Task enumeration.
phase_B: Bounded dependent graph reads for VM blocks, map rows, definition IDs and skill state. Optional failures must not discard already saved core data.
phase_C: Check boundary, lifetime, all group timing and original-thread/fiber continuity. Equal coarse counters alone do not prove atomicity.
native_resume_option: Original VM/Task can remain in old process rather than be reimplemented, but then no-double-execution, pause/resume, one-time native finish and rollback still require real tests.
